description: Up-vote ("up"), down-vote ("down") or remove your vote ("clear") on a place, by place_id from get_plan. Changes only the participant bound to the supplied credentials. Current stored state is available through get_plan. Do not call this tool when the user says they are under 13 (or a known higher local minimum), even with a nickname: explain that lesgooo is not available to them. Do not write another known underage child's personal data, sensitive medical records, intimate content, card details, IDs, passwords or verification codes. Offer ordinary non-sensitive planning text instead; do not replace a restricted request with an unrequested plan.

place_id.description: From get_plan places[].place_id or add_place (the exact place name also works).

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character id. Bare module links such as https://lesgooo.fun/when are local drafts: ask for a saved link, never substitute a previous plan ID.

name: vote_place
title: Vote on a place
